draw.formula: lowest sha256 wins over the unverified set
draw.lease: while you hold an unexpired handout you are handed the same claim every time; re-requesting is not a re-roll
draw.seed: utf8(public_key_base64 + '|' + head_commit_hex + '|' + claim_id), claim_id including its 'sha256:' prefix

url_shape.slug: lowercase alphanumeric words from the proposition, stopwords removed, first 7 joined by hyphens — derived, not chosen. Use /claims/index.json rather than constructing these.
